description: This file contains shell functions for platform-specific checks and upgrade procedures, particularly for a device identified as dlink,dir-685. It includes functions to verify image compatibility and perform upgrades, with some conditional logic based on device identifiers.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the current device's board is supported for the image. Returns 0 if supported, otherwise outputs a message indicating lack of support and returns 1.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade procedure for the device if supported, setting the partition name and invoking a default upgrade method.
